testcase.name: Category definitions generate both variant inputs and localized public filters with their selected values
Boolean false and decimal filters retain their values in SSR instead of becoming empty
Percentage input converts to exact basis points and Douala dates round trip without browser timezone dependence
All 110 master scenarios remain in the launch matrix exactly once
Reference copies retain the exact originals, including the logo used by both apps
OpenAPI references resolve and all private operations declare session security
Every stock and procurement route has a matching secured contract and retry requirements
Every customer request and cart route declares its ownership and retry boundary
